checks: Coefficient class count uses coker(N mod n)<=n^v and O(t) SNC data, not det N or a uniform splitting cover.
Only the rank-M^2 punctured anchor is needed. All orders/modules used in coordinates are ordinary canonical full pullbacks on the original comparable-cycle model.
Frobenius full-order/source comparison has the explicit forward map and inverse pC via source factorization; scaling the opposite comparison module gives actual pairings and conductor(p+1)C.
Full-bundle degree and -Z generation give bounded-rank fixed order/reference budgets O_B(t), variable coarse-module budgets O_B(tr).
Within a realized coefficient class, anchor determinants cancel against one reference: the ratio is the hth power of an ordinary finite scalar character. One initial character determines all phases.
Nonnegative full-module multidegrees have weighted sum O_B(tr); negative definiteness yields actual finite extension-line lists with no moving Picard basis variables.
Nonreduced quotient resolutions are locally split over every coefficient ring. Exact top-top, mixed and bottom blocks have O(t)*O(r^2), O(tr)*O(r), O(tr)*O(1) sizes.

The action is one global morphism, not one matrix per algebra generator. Associativity and correspondence relations use bounded fixed tensor words and two variable object ends; finite Hom boundary witnesses encode actual map equalities.
The all-ring simultaneous action/unit/cocycle effectivity is assumed explicitly and never inferred from local Newton or rank alone.

Generated-source Hartogs extends P-linearity because the action relation vanishes in a Cartier-torsion-free target. Fixed determinant and adjugates bound specified Artinian comparison poles independently of nilpotence. The finite Isom statement remains the second explicit dependency.
The component prefactor N+1 is retained; all list and component costs absorb into q^(A_R,B*t*r^2).
Determinant of matrix lifts makes the full central obstruction r-torsion, giving geometric period dividing gcd(r,q-1); no semilinear or full-FG consequence is claimed.
